connector.name: Computer-Use Agents API
connector.registryDescription: Run and manage H Company's Computer-Use Agents from any MCP client.
connector.summary: Hosted at agp.hcompany.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hcompai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
